headline: Keyence -5.1% in Tokyo day before 1:5 split
summary: JPY 13,945 Nov 20 close (split-adjusted) from 14,690; no company news found.

headline: Nvidia falls 3.3% despite record Q3
summary: Q3 revenue up 103% to $115.8B and Q4 guide of about $130B beat, but CEO transition and a US block on remote Chinese access to its chips weighed. Early 4.7% gain erased.

headline: Anthropic closes up 17% on Nasdaq debut
summary: Priced at $83, opened at $111.50, up as much as 27% intraday, closed +17%, slipped about 2% after hours. Largest IPO on record.

headline: Alphabet down 3.5% as Anthropic listing values its stake
summary: The debut put a public price on Google's Anthropic stake, but Alphabet sold off with other AI names in the afternoon.

headline: Micron was an Anthropic IPO anchor buyer
summary: Micron is one of seven companies that bought Anthropic shares at the IPO price and supplies it memory. Stock rose early, closed -2.1%.

headline: Marvell cut to Hold/Neutral by TD Cowen and BofA
summary: Both cite mid-single-digit EPS dilution from the all-stock Lumentum deal; options price an ~11% move on upcoming Q3 results. Closed -4.9%.

headline: AMD closes -7.7% at $489.19 after short-seller report
summary: Chip selloff broadened: VRT -4.9%, MELI -4.8%, NVDA -3.3%, CRWV -6.1%; 10-yr eased to 5.04%.

headline: Alibaba AI cloud revenue up 53%, earnings miss
summary: AI Cloud and Compute revenue rose 53% to 60.97B yuan; group revenue up 10% slightly beat, but adjusted EPS of 8.10 yuan missed 10.75 expected and free cash outflow widened.

headline: Anthropic opens 34% above IPO price in record debut
summary: ANT opened 34% above its $83 IPO price, about $2T market cap, then faded to roughly +18% midday. The IPO raised about $81B, the largest on record.

headline: BofA cuts MercadoLibre PT to $2,000
summary: From $2,400; stock -3.5% intraday.

headline: Anthropic debuts 34% above IPO price, but market reverses lower
summary: ANT priced at $83 and opened at $111.50, raising about $81bn. Broader indexes turned down by midday, Dow off about 1,000 points.

headline: Keyence 1:5 split takes effect Nov 21
summary: Shares quoted split-adjusted at JPY 14,600; interim dividend raised to JPY 325.

headline: Anthropic prices record IPO at $83
summary: Anthropic raised over $81B, topping SpaceX as the largest IPO ever.

headline: Anthropic prices IPO above range
summary: Anthropic priced its Nasdaq IPO at $83 a share, above the $70-78 range; trading as ANT expected to start Nov 19. Final share count and proceeds pending the prospectus.

headline: Dow down 1.1%, Nasdaq up 0.4% on Nov 18
Neocloud CDS spreads widen; CoreWeave -4.1%
summary: CNBC: debt worries push neocloud CDS higher; short-credit ETFs may list.

headline: Erste cuts GE Vernova to Hold
summary: Cites slower pace of new customer orders despite strong backlog. GEV -1.0%.

headline: Nvidia falls about 2% despite beat as board rules out Huang return
summary: Shares reversed an early gain after board chair Harvey Jones said Huang will not be reinstated; Colette Kress stays interim CEO and the outlook assumes no China data center revenue.

headline: Nvidia beats in first report without Huang, guides Q4 to $130B
summary: Q3 revenue $115.8B (+103%), data center $107.6B; Q4 guide $130B vs $124.9B consensus; interim CEO Kress lifted FY28 growth outlook to 75%. Shares still fell 2.9% on Nov 18.

headline: Nvidia Q3 FY27 revenue $115.8B, up 103%; guides Q4 to $130B
summary: Data centre revenue $107.6B (+110% y/y), non-GAAP gross margin 74.9%. Q4 outlook $130B ±3% assumes no China data centre compute.

headline: Nvidia adds $150B to buyback, returned $28.1B in Q3
summary: About $227.3B remains under the authorization; quarterly dividend held at $0.25. Shares rose about 4.8% after hours.

headline: Nvidia board forms national security and export control oversight committee
summary: Announced alongside results and expanded supply-chain partner commitments, the first quarter under interim CEO Colette Kress.

headline: Chip suppliers jump after hours on Nvidia beat
summary: Micron +4.7%, TSMC +4.6% and Marvell +5.7% after hours, reversing session losses for Micron and TSMC.

headline: Alibaba slips 4.4% ahead of Nov 19 results
summary: Pressure from a pending US rule barring Chinese AI firms from advanced chips in offshore data centres, plus its Megaspeed links. Results due Nov 19.

headline: Enphase falls 7.6%, extending slide since weak Q4 guide
summary: No new company news found; shares continue lower after late-October Q3 miss and soft Q4 guidance.

headline: TSMC down 3.7% in session before Nvidia rebound
summary: Fell with the semiconductor group into the print, then regained 4.6% after hours.

headline: US tightens China AI chip access; TSMC down 3.5%
summary: Asian chipmakers fell again after a new US curb; TAIEX fell 1.7% after a roughly 6% drop Monday.

headline: Micron slips 3% as GF Securities cuts NAND price forecasts
summary: The cut revives fears of NAND oversupply next year, following a 7.5% intraday drop Monday.

headline: Blackstone buys majority of Amazon data-centre portfolio for about $5B
summary: Separately, a ULA Vulcan failure destroyed 40 Amazon Leo satellites, and Zoox robotaxis went live on Uber in Las Vegas.

headline: UBS cuts Alphabet to Neutral on TPU demand concerns
summary: Target cut 16%. Separately, a Gemini 3.5 Pro class action has a lead-plaintiff deadline of Dec 1.

headline: Netflix cuts more games staff; Pershing Square raises stake
summary: Second round of games-unit layoffs. Ackman's fund lifted its holding in Q3. Stock down 2%.

headline: Chip rout: SOX -5.3%, Nasdaq in correction
summary: New US licensing for AI chip shipments to five countries plus Nvidia leadership doubts hit semis: Micron -7.6%, Marvell -7.3%, TSMC ADR -6.3%. Nasdaq is now more than 10% below its Oct 6 record.

headline: Chip stocks slide as traders unwind Nvidia-rival bets before earnings
summary: Marvell fell about 7% and Micron about 7%; Bessent gave Nvidia's board 10 days to answer on export-control compliance.

headline: Board not considering Huang's return, CNBC source says
summary: A person familiar told CNBC the board is focused on a national security probe into Huang and is not in talks to reinstate him; some investors want options kept open.

headline: US interim rule curbs remote access to advanced chips via third countries
summary: Commerce rule targets offshore data-centre workarounds; interim CEO Kress leads Nvidia's Tue call. Anthropic debut eyed Nov 19.

headline: Nvidia crisis drags chips; board not bringing back Huang
summary: Huang exit tied to national security probe; export curbs widened to five more countries. NVDA -4%, chip names -4 to -7%.

headline: SK Hynix ADR -5.8% on Nvidia turmoil and DRAM price-fixing suit
summary: Lawsuit adds legal risk to memory leader.

headline: Law firm opens investigation into Bloom Energy officers
summary: BE -7.6%; moved to watch.

headline: Asia mostly lower Monday after weak Japan and China data; Kospi -2.8%, Nikkei -1.6%
summary: Japan's preliminary Q3 GDP showed a surprise 0.1% annualised contraction and China's October industrial output and retail sales disappointed. Tech led losses in Tokyo and Seoul. The Hang Seng rose 0.9% on consumer and EV names.

headline: Nvidia ends week down 12.75% ahead of Tuesday earnings
summary: Nvidia fell about 2% Friday, 12.75% for the week; Tuesday's report is the first read on demand since the CEO change.

headline: HSBC downgrades Nvidia to Hold after Huang exit
summary: HSBC cut its target to $170 from $365, saying investor confidence is shaken. The stock fell again Friday, extending Thursday's 4% drop.

headline: OpenAI reportedly raising $15B at $1.25T valuation
summary: Half the $30B initially sought and below a $1.4T target, per CNBC sources. About 47% above the March round's $852B post-money.

headline: Meta rises about 2% against falling Nasdaq
summary: Meta traded higher midday Friday on light volume while chips dragged the index lower.

headline: 10y yield hits 5.17%, Fed hike bets build
summary: October PPI rose 0.3% vs 0.4% expected, but yields stayed above 5.1% and December hike odds rose.

headline: Robinhood among six brokers selling Anthropic IPO shares to retail
summary: Robinhood joins Schwab, Fidelity, SoFi, E*TRADE and others in the retail allocation; HOOD rose 4% on Nov 12.

headline: Nvidia closes down 4.3% after Huang resigns; Kress interim CEO
summary: Fell as much as 14% intraday before paring. CFO Colette Kress is interim CEO; Harvey Jones becomes first board chair. Bernstein halved its target. Q3 results still due Nov 17.

headline: Nvidia down 11% since Nov 6 and 31% below its Oct 6 record
summary: Market value finished about $4.0T. Index funds fell about 0.35%; small caps (IWM) fell 1.6%.

headline: 10-year yield jumps 13bp to 5.125%; December Fed hike fully priced
summary: 2-year up 15bp to 4.879%. Goldman added a March hike. WTI +2% to $88.74, Brent +3% to $95.82 after Trump said no Iran deal needed.

headline: Robinhood October: $383B platform assets, 28.9M funded customers
summary: Monthly operating data released; shares fell 3.8% on the day.

headline: Jensen Huang resigns; CFO Colette Kress named interim CEO
summary: Huang left as CEO and director effective immediately. Harvey Jones becomes first board chair and the board is searching inside and outside for a permanent CEO.

headline: Figure Q3: marketplace volume +135%, EBITDA margin 58%
summary: Adjusted EBITDA rose 91%. Management flagged seasonal and acquisition costs pressuring Q4 margins; shares rose about 10%.

headline: Alibaba drops about 7% on China AI chip worries
summary: ADRs fell midday as Nvidia's leadership shock revived chip-supply concerns; T-Head has filed for a Hong Kong IPO and results land Nov 19.

headline: AMD up ~5% as rivals gain on Nvidia exit; BofA target $700
summary: William Blair upgraded to Outperform; AMD to invest in PsiQuantum.

headline: Broadcom up ~5% on rotation from Nvidia
summary: Custom-chip makers bid as Nvidia shares fell.

headline: Astera sees Scorpio X above $1B run rate by end-2026
summary: Said at BMO conference; rising silicon content per XPU.

headline: Vertiv launches PowerNexus medium-voltage UPS for AI sites
summary: Outdoor-rated MV system; shares +2.7%.

headline: Four brokers cut Sea targets after Q3 EPS miss
summary: BofA $110, TD Cowen $90, StoneX $155, Barclays $150.

headline: Anthropic IPO reportedly several times oversubscribed
summary: Bloomberg-sourced reports say orders are several times the 825M shares on offer at $70-78; up to $90.4B raised including a private placement; pricing Nov 18, Nasdaq trading as ANT Nov 19. Talk of a valuation above the range.

headline: OpenAI's direct model supply to Cursor due to end today
summary: OpenAI proposed Nov 12 as the date to wind down its direct model-supply deal with Cursor, which SpaceX now owns. Not confirmed by a primary source.

headline: Options price about 10.6% Nvidia earnings move
summary: Consensus Q3 revenue about $109B, up 91%; Q4 guide expected to drive the reaction amid governance probe.

headline: WSJ: Nvidia board preparing to oust Huang
summary: Board could meet Wednesday night; no successor or board chair. NYT also reported a second relationship, with an executive. Shares down over 7% after hours. No decision reported yet.

headline: Micron up 11.9% on CoreWeave beat and Anthropic allocation
summary: CoreWeave revenue up 168% with a $132.5B backlog revived the memory trade; amended Anthropic IPO filing names Micron for a $1B placement allocation.

headline: Chips lead rebound: S&P tech sector up 2.7%
summary: Marvell up 9.3%, TSMC up 4.3%, Nvidia up 2.9% in session before the after-hours drop. S&P 500 up 1.3%, Nasdaq up 1.6%.

headline: Apple closes at record high, China Renaissance upgrades to Buy
summary: Shares rose about 2% to about $355.63, an all-time closing high, for a market value of about $5.1T. China Renaissance upgraded to Buy with a $425 target.

headline: Cloudflare up 3% as analysts split
summary: Closed at $315.00 (+3%). DZ Bank upgraded to Buy ($300 target); Guggenheim keeps Sell.

headline: Kospi +2.6%, SK hynix +5.4%; Korea chip exports +331% Nov 1-10
summary: Nikkei +1.3%. Samsung +3.4%, Kioxia +5.6%. Lower oil and Iran talk hopes helped.

headline: Anthropic pulled its first IPO range as inaccurate; amended filing shows $70-78
summary: A $70-80 range for ~867m shares was retracted. The amended filing shows ~825m shares at $70-78, with pricing expected 18 Nov and trading 19 Nov.

headline: Anthropic sets terms: 825M shares at $70-78, about $61B raise
summary: About $1.2T fully diluted value at midpoint. Nasdaq ticker ANT; expected to price and trade week of Nov 16 (Nov 19 listing is Thu morning AEST Nov 20).

headline: Robinhood listed among retail brokers for the Anthropic IPO
summary: CFO says it is 'making sure the companies know retail is here'. Separately, the stock fell 8% on Oct 28 after a Q3 EPS miss.

headline: October CPI +0.4% m/m, core +0.3%, both above forecast
summary: S&P 500 -0.4%, Nasdaq -0.7%, Dow -0.3%. No y/y figure (2025 shutdown gap). Shelter over 30% of the rise. Gold -2.6%.

headline: Fed hike odds jump; Waller had flagged 50bp if core hit 0.3%
summary: Core came in at 0.3%. Logan backs at least two more 25bp hikes. Futures price a December hike as near certain.

headline: Anthropic sets IPO range $70-78, up to $1.4T valuation
summary: 825M shares on Nasdaq as ANT. Pricing expected Nov 18, trading Nov 19. Valuation below earlier $2T talk; book reportedly covered.

headline: Nasdaq-100 +3.4% while Nvidia lost about $200B
summary: CNBC: Nasdaq-100 was as oversold as at the March 30 low; SOX needs another 9% to clear its 20-day average.

headline: TSMC October revenue +59.7% y/y
summary: NT$586.9B, up 14.7% on September. Year to date up 43.3%.

headline: Anthropic aims for Nasdaq debut as ANT next week
summary: WSJ says trading targets Thursday or Friday, Nov 19-20, with Goldman and Morgan Stanley setting the range. Nvidia and Alphabet pledged $10B each at the IPO price.

headline: S&P 500 +2.35%, Nasdaq +2.74%, chip index +6.85%
summary: Best S&P day since April 8 after the worst week since April 2025. Dow +1,104. Brent -5.85% to $92.57. October CPI due Wednesday.

headline: Nvidia -4.3% as board probes CEO; chips rally without it
summary: Board opened an investigation into Jensen Huang's relationship with an alleged Chinese spy. Stock fell up to 8% intraday, lowest close since April 7.

headline: loanDepot Q3: loss widens to $29M, volume down 12%
summary: Revenue $307M (-9% q/q). Margin up 54bp to 399bp. Q4 volume guide $4.5-6.5B vs $7.05B in Q3. Seeking refinancing of debt maturities. Stock -17%.

headline: JPMorgan adds Meta to focus list; Meta +5%, Amazon +3%
summary: Meta and Amazon are JPMorgan's preferred internet picks; Alphabet removed but stays overweight. Meta Q3 ad revenue +26%.

headline: Marvell +9.5% with chips, no company news
summary: B. Riley cut target to $250, Cantor to $225 (neutral). Lumentum all-stock deal remains the overhang.
